summary: Bilingual first-party discovery identified Bangladesh DLRS/Settlement cadastral map and khatian services and the Shariatpur/Bhedarganj local record context. Current official route inspection returned Shariatpur district metadata but an empty survey list; the official DLRS Map Portal returned zero Afamolla mouza matches in English and Bangla. No safe native parcel ID plus polygon was returned.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, request methods, statuses, payload scope, route observations, and limitations are recorded in city-6736-afamolla.json.

custodians.name: Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS), Bangladesh / Online Land Records and Survey Management
custodians.scope: National cadastral survey, khatian, mouza-map, and public map-search services.
custodians.evidence: Official DLRS pages, Settlement.gov.bd MapSearch, current MapSearch.js, and live division/district route responses.

custodians.name: Shariatpur District record room and Bhedarganj/union land-office context
custodians.scope: Local administrative record custody and land-office service context; exact Afamolla mouza coverage was not established.
custodians.evidence: Official Shariatpur district and union/Bhedarganj pages listed in the city record.

safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel identifier if publicly returned and source-proven
registryBasis: A current official DLRS/Settlement cadastral map service and official Shariatpur/Bhedarganj record-office context were evidenced. This does not establish open citywide geometry completeness.
coverageLimits: No survey identifier was returned for Shariatpur by the current official district survey route.
The official Map Portal returned zero English and Bangla Afamolla mouza matches; this is not evidence that Afamolla has no parcels.
The exact WUP point was preserved and was not used as an absence test.
No citywide, districtwide, or countrywide parcel geometry coverage was qualified.
uncertainty: Current service inventory may omit unpublished, scanned-only, or differently spelled mouza records.
The viewer's documented Dag_No field and parcel tile route were not backed by a returned Afamolla feature response.
No unsafe fields were requested or retained.
doNotInfer: No geometry is not evidence that Afamolla has no parcels.
Packet completion is not source integration or admission.
